Purseinator — Test Reports

Latest CI results from main. Each report updates independently.

End-to-end →

Playwright suite across tablet, phone, and desktop. Traces and screenshots on failure. Updates when the UI/presentation layer changes.

Coverage →

Vitest line/branch/function coverage, browsable per file. Updates on every main push.

Coverage reflects unit and component tests only — the database integration suite runs in a separate CI job and is not counted here, so the percentage is a floor, not the total. End-to-end coverage is not instrumented.
